title: The Importance of the Good Example in the Tarbiyah of Children

text_simplified: The text points out that parents are role models for their children. If a father has poor akhlaq or neglects prayer, his children will be influenced by his behavior and imitate him. Therefore, the greatest injustice against children is neglecting their tarbiyah and failing to teach them goodness, which leads them to grow up with bad behaviors.

review_defects.why: The Arabic 'تاركًا للصلاة' means 'abandoning prayer' or 'leaving prayer', which is stronger than 'neglects prayer'. The English softens the severity.
The Arabic 'جريمة' means 'crime', not 'injustice'. The English changes the word and softens the original meaning.
